questions.question: Before meeting his brother Esau, Jacob sent a large gift of animals ahead. What was he hoping the gift would do?

answers.text: Win Esau over before they meet
Pay Esau for crossing his land

questions.question: Jacob feared his brother Esau and split his people into two camps. If Esau attacked one camp, what could the other do?
Afraid of his brother Esau, Jacob prayed to God. What did Jacob ask God to do?

answers.text: Lead him safely back to Laban
Send the angels to fight for him

questions.question: When Jacob prayed in fear of his brother Esau, which promise from God did he remind God of?

answers.text: Offspring like the sand of the sea
A land flowing with milk and honey
A throne that will last forever
